coverage.note: Bounded source-reviewed Nov 16–17 window: 11 accepted reports from first-party announcements, an official legal filing, Reuters reporting and research preprints. GitHub, Tencent and arXiv dates independently checked; Reuters financing/robotics plans reported, not independently replicated. California allegations are NOT court findings. K2 Horizon proposal deferred after a date conflict with the institute's September 3, 2026 release; VoxMel access and Garlic's original publication date remain unresolved. All five technology and three terminology proposals remain pending catalog deduplication, primary-source and license review. One arXiv API failure disclosed. Collection is partial, not exhaustive.

sources_failed.note: arXiv API unavailable through this tool; individual arXiv/Hugging Face paper pages were reviewed instead. No zero-results inference.

tldr: Tencent's sparse Hy4 flash announcement and four GitHub developer/security updates join research on model distillation, model fingerprinting and large-scale robot policies; vendor and preprint claims remain attributed.

November 17 coverage also includes Reuters reporting on robotics financing and factory automation, plus a California lawsuit whose assertions are allegations rather than proven incidents. Eight catalog proposals and three news candidates remain deferred for further review.

news.title: Tencent unveils Hy4 flash: sparse, long-context multimodal inference
news.summary: Tencent announced a 224B-total-parameter Hy4 flash model with 12B active parameters, Engram components and a claimed one-million-token context. Tencent advertises TokenHub availability and lower token pricing than Hy4.
news.why_it_matters: A new sparse-inference option may help teams balance long-context API usage with latency and expense.
news.caveat: Parameter counts, relative performance, throughput and prices are Tencent-reported, not independently benchmarked. Announced future open weights are not available weights.

news.title: GitHub adds up-to-20-repository bulk starts for AI Scan
news.summary: GitHub made a public-preview bulk action to launch AI Scan across up to 20 repositories, with findings integrated into existing code-scanning alerts.
news.why_it_matters: Security teams can investigate many codebases without launching separate scans for each repository.
news.caveat: This is a workflow change to AI Scan, not evidence of complete vulnerability detection. Prior November 13 repository-level API controls are a separate already-covered feature.

news.title: GitHub introduces plugin-only rules for enterprise Copilot customizations
news.summary: GitHub enterprise administrators can apply strictPluginOnlyCustomization to skills, agents, hooks, MCP servers and executable Copilot extensions, permitting controlled plugins or managed settings instead of standalone user/project variants.
news.why_it_matters: Organizations gain a concrete enforcement layer for where agent tools and executable extensions originate.
news.caveat: Plugin-only is not a marketplace allowlist; GitHub says administrators must combine it with marketplace policy to restrict which plugin sources are eligible. Plan and administrative availability apply.

news.title: VS Code starts transition away from the Local Copilot harness
news.summary: GitHub says VS Code 1.146 deprecates the old Local harness and plans its removal in February 2027. The newer Copilot harness has been the default for new sessions since 1.143.
news.why_it_matters: Coding-agent users must test compatibility of sessions, tools and customizations before the future removal.
news.caveat: The old harness was deprecated, not removed on November 16. Local code execution still exists; choosing the newer harness does not automatically turn on sandboxing.

news.title: Copilot retires three older model choices, with documented exceptions
news.summary: GitHub lists November 16 deprecations for Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Terra across most Copilot experiences, recommending supported replacements.
news.why_it_matters: Model-selection changes can break fixed-model assumptions in coding-agent evaluations and enterprise policies.
news.caveat: GitHub explicitly retains Opus 4.8 for individual annual subscribers and Opus 5 for certain runtime refusal fallbacks; this is distinct from a separately announced December 14 deprecation batch.

news.title: California files suit alleging unsafe AI-agent security testing
news.summary: California's Attorney General announced a lawsuit filed November 16 alleging that OpenAI's experimental agent testing and cyber controls created risks and violated California law. The release cites prior incidents and investigative claims.
news.why_it_matters: The filing brings AI-agent containment, authorization and testing safeguards into an active legal dispute.
news.caveat: The filing and allegations are real; the allegations themselves are not established findings of fact or court judgments. Do not promote the claimed incidents or 80-incident figure into confirmed Atlas incident records.

news.title: Genesis AI reports $500M round for Eno mobile manipulation robot
news.summary: Reuters reports French robotics company Genesis AI says it raised $500 million at a $3.5 billion valuation and will expand production, data collection and training for its wheeled Eno robot.
news.why_it_matters: Funding and small customer tests point to continued investment in real-world manipulation, alongside model-training and robotics data needs.
news.caveat: The financing terms and prospective broader customer rollout in 2027 are reported and forward-looking; funding does not establish autonomous production readiness or generalization.

news.title: Reuters: GM targets more plant robotics by 2028
news.summary: Reuters reports that sources familiar with the plans say GM targets roughly 20% more robotics and automation across North American factories by 2028, including developing its own mobile robots in Indiana.
news.why_it_matters: An industrial deployment plan illustrates demand for practical mobile-robot systems beyond laboratory benchmarks.
news.caveat: This is Reuters source-based reporting on a target, not a completed 20% expansion or verification of independent robot performance. Operational and workforce effects remain uncertain.

news.title: ScaleVLA paper studies a 552B backbone for robot manipulation
news.summary: ScaleVLA connects a 552B vision-language backbone to an action diffusion transformer and reports better sample efficiency and contact-sensitive manipulation than smaller baselines in its chosen evaluations.
news.why_it_matters: Provides testable evidence toward studying whether large pretrained representations can benefit low-demonstration robotic policies.
news.caveat: Only the researchers' comparisons are available; the paper is not a verified industrial deployment, and 552B scale introduces significant inference cost and reproducibility constraints.

news.title: Concertina folds pretrained layers into a smaller weight-sharing student
news.summary: Concertina reuses teacher weights by executing a shared block repeatedly with initialized low-rank layer corrections and token-dependent gates; the authors report a Qwen3-4B derived 2.27B model trained on 22B distillation tokens.
news.why_it_matters: Could reduce the data needed to derive a compact student when good teacher checkpoints are available, without training a new network from scratch.
news.caveat: The authors' 84% average retention over eight tests and comparison with other baselines are not independently reproduced; student performance may differ outside the test suite. November 13 paper is catch-up.

news.title: Model-fingerprint paper finds conversational style can undermine API audits
news.summary: A November 13 preprint reports that model-identification fingerprints shift toward the authors of earlier conversation turns, weakening some mid-conversation API-substitution checks. Its Lineup technique compares a reply with samples drawn on the same conversational history.
news.why_it_matters: Auditors may need history-matched references rather than assuming fresh-prompt model fingerprints hold across long sessions.
news.caveat: Research experiments and author-reported error rates do not establish that a particular provider substituted models or that Lineup universally detects it. This is a catch-up research finding.
